tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gnod byed 'byung po'i gsur bsngo rkyen ngan kun grol bzhugs so// phye mar sha khrag sogs zas sna gang 'dzoms/ dam rdzas myong grol yod na bsre/ mchan/ mer bsreg chab bran la/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ hrīḥlas rang nyid 'phags mchog snying rje'i rje mkhyen brtse'i gsung gter/ /zla mdog phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pad dkar/ /zhabs gnyis sems skyil pad zla'i gdan la rol/ /dar dang rin chen rgyan mdzes gsal bar gyur/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ ci nus bzla/ rang spyan ras gzigs su bsgoms nas dmigs yul rnams la snying rje drag tu bskyed de/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta sogs/ saṃ bha ra bdun dang / mtshan bzhi brjod pas dmigs yul rnams kyi ci 'dod pa'i longs spyod 'dzad med bde ba chen por byin gyis brlabs la/ hoḥgasur mchod 'dod yon drug ldan pa/ /rang rang yid la gang 'dod sprin/ /gnam sa bar snang kun khyab cing / /'dzad med bde ba'i gter chen 'di/ /rigs drug snying rje'i mgron rnams dang / /khyad par phyogs 'dir rgyu ba yi/ /bgegs rigs lan chags sha 'khon can/ /za mgron shi gshed gri pho mo/ /nad bdag rims bdag god kha'i bdag /yul 'dre rbad 'dre nye du'i 'dre/ /chags dang 'jungs pa'i 'du shes kyis/ /mi dang nor phyir 'brang ba 'am/ /phrag dog sdang ba'i bsam pa yis/ /gnod pa rtsom pa'i rigs kun dang / /dri za srid pa bar ma'i 'gro/ /ltogs 'gong bse rag yi dwags rigs/ /srid pa las kyi dbang song bas/ /sna tshogs gzugs can kun tu rgyu/ /sna tshogs zas can yongs tshol can/ /bsam sbyor sna tshogs mi 'dra ba/ /gnod pa sna tshogs kun tu sbyor/ /dbang chen dbang chung sna tshogs pa'i/ /gdon bgegs 'byung po thams cad la/ /pham rgyal phyogs lhung med pa yi/ /'dod rgu mi zad gter du bsngo/ /yid la ci 'dod thob gyur nas/ /gnod 'tshe gdug rtsub kun zhi zhing /

/byang chub sems dang ldan gyur cig /srog la rlom zhing bla la 'jab/ /nor la rngam zhing zas la rku/ /dpal la gnod pa'i 'byung po rnams/ /mchod sbyin 'di yis tshim gyur cig /tshe rabs lan chags byang gyur cig /sha 'khon sdig sgrib dag gyur cig /sdug bsngal nyon mongs zhi gyur cig /bdag gis mchod sbyin 'di bsngos pas/ /'byung po'i tshogs kun tshim gyur nas/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad kun/ /dus min 'chi dang nad la sogs/ /'gal rkyen kun dang bral gyur cig /re zhing chags rnams gtan du tshim/ /lus gdon gnas gdon la sogs grol/ /'dod don bar chad ma lus zhi/ /bkra shis bde legs phun tshogs shog /mnyam nyid byang chub sems kyi mthus/ /gnod bya gnod byed thams cad kun/ /chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i ngang / /dbyer med sangs rgyas thob par shog /thams cad nam mkha' sogs/ zag med 'dod yon drug ldan la/ /zhen med tshul du longs spyod nas/ /bdag med mnyam pa'i don rtogs te/ /skye med chos sku thob par shog /rnam snang mngon byang las so/ bdag gi bsod nams stobs dag dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin stobs dang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs kyis su/ /sems can rnams la phan 'dogs pas/ /don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun/ /'jig rten khams ni ma lus 'dir/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs par/ /thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /gu ru rin po che'i gsung / zhes byas la dmigs 'dun de dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas/ khams gsum dag pa'i zhing : srid gsum thugs rje'i mgron: ma lus khyab pa'i zas: chos nyid rtogs pa'i mthus: mi zad gter du bsngo: oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ci rigs dang chos rje ngag dbang legs pa'i gsung / 'dir tshogs snying rje'i mgron rigs thams cad la/ /bdag gis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /gsung mchog yi ge drug pa'i bzlas lung sbyin/ /khyod rnams rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis nyon/

/ma ṇi brgya rtsa bgrangs nas/ mdo las gsungs pa'i tshigs bcad do/ /sbyin pa rgya cher gyur pa 'di yi mthus/ /'gro ba'i nang nas rang byung sangs rgyas shog /sngon tshe rgyal ba rnams kyis ma bsgral ba'i/ /skye rgu 'di dag sbyin pas sgrol gyur cig /sogs smon lam dang / 'byung po gang dag 'dir ni sogs dang / bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod par bya'o/ /'di ni sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs pa dang bar chad zhi ba'i thabs khyad par can yin pas sus kyang nyams su blang bar byas la/ lhag par dus ngan gyi sems can rnams brnab sems dang brkam chags 'phel ba'i skabs su za 'dre 'gong po mang zhing mi phyugs la 'tshe ba dang / longs spyod la gnod pa mang ba'i dus dang / zas nor gyi phyir yul sna tshogs su rgyu ba'i skabs dang / nad rims phyugs god mang zhing rmi lam ngan pa'i skabs dang / gcan spyang byi ba sogs kyis gnod pa dang / 'dre gdon dang 'dri dogs che ba'i skabs sogs su byas na bar chad dang gnod pa zhi/ rgyun dang skabs su snying rjes kun nas bslangs te byas na 'chi ba bslu/ nad gdon bral/ sris rme/ mthun rkyen 'phel/ tshogs rdzogs pa sogs rang gzhan la 'phral dang yun gyi phan pa'i dgos pa du ma yod pa ni smos ma dgos pas nan tan bya'o/ /ces pa'ang rgyal stod dbang phug tu rmi lam rkyen las phyir nang zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bco brgyad la mi pham pas phan sems kyis bris pa dge bar gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// glud byed na/ glud gtor 'dod yon drug ldan 'di zhes kha bsgyur la bsngo bar bya'o/ /bhu bhaṃ// ༈ //kun mkhyen mi pham rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsur bsngo byin rlabs can 'di la/ dbu'i skyabs sems/ tshad med bzhi/ lhar bskyed/ mjug gi ma ṇi bzla ba'i mtshams sbyor rnams 'jam mgon bla ma rin po che ngag dbang legs pa'i phyag bzhes zhal gsung ltar bkod pa yin no/

༈ /dus gsum bde gshegs sangs rgyas sras dang bcas/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang / /khyad par rigs gsum mgon dang pad+ma 'byung / /bslu med skyabs gnas rnams kyi bden pa yis/ /nam mkhar sprin bsdus sa gzhir drod phob la/ /sad kyi 'jigs pa las ni bskyab tu gsol/ /ces mchog gling gter kha las so/ /kunaṃ la sman 'dod bum bzang las/ /legs byas dgaṃ' ston mdzad med 'dis/ /snyigs ma'i rgud pa mthar byas te/ /chosaṃ srid dpal 'byor daraṃ rgyas shog /ces smon tshig 'di'ang snang rtse ri khrod nas mañjus spel ba dge legs su gyur cig /sarba dā shrī ya sid+dhir+bha wa tu// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sga ston ngag dbang legs pa/ gnod byed 'byung po'i gsur bsngo rkyen ngan kun grol/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
